jei.carves_and_crafts.info.carving_bench: Carve and paint pumpkins here. Put a pumpkin, a carving knife and a paintbrush in the bench, then press Carve. The Palette tab crafts color palettes; the Schematics tab keeps your designs.
jei.carves_and_crafts.info.carving_knife: Cuts holes in pumpkins at the carving bench. Each cut pixel uses 1 durability.
jei.carves_and_crafts.info.paintbrush: Paints pumpkins at the carving bench. Each painted pixel uses 1 paint. Refill it with a color palette in the bench.
jei.carves_and_crafts.info.color_palette: Made in the Palette tab of the carving bench. Refills a paintbrush completely and unlocks every color.
jei.carves_and_crafts.info.pumpkin: Grows from pumpkin seeds on farmland, or found wild in some biomes. Carve it at the carving bench; right-click a placed pumpkin with a torch or candle to light it.
jei.carves_and_crafts.info.seeds: Craft from a blank pumpkin of the same variety (4 seeds). Plant on farmland.
